https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/blob/5c970a863ce2fdd87b6e23ffb4822f6d76522b1c/serve/server.py#L408-L458
408:     def __init__(self, exe: str, args: list[str], cwd: str | None = None, log: str | None = None,
409:                  env: dict | None = None):
410:         self.spawn = (exe, list(args), cwd, log, env)   # to start it again after it died (issue #27)
411:         paths = {k: v for k, v in zip(args, args[1:]) if k in ("--native", "--pack")}
412:         self.model_path = paths.get("--native") or paths.get("--pack", "pack/full")
413:         self.log_path = log
414:         self.log = open(log, "a", encoding="utf-8") if log else subprocess.DEVNULL
415:         loading = threading.Event()                     # set once READY: the narrator below stops
416:         log_start = os.path.getsize(log) if log else 0
417:         if log:
418:             threading.Thread(target=narrate_start, args=(log, log_start, args, loading),
419:                              daemon=True).start()
420:         self.proc = subprocess.Popen([exe, "--serve", *args], cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
421:                                      stderr=self.log, text=True, encoding="utf-8", bufsize=1, env=env)
422:         self.max_context = 0
423:         self.can_stop = False            # the engine honours a STOP line mid-request (READY <ctx> stop)
424:         self.can_pause = False           # ... and PAUSE: a STOP that keeps the state with what was written (fair slices)
425:         self.multi = 0                   # READY ... multi=<n>: n conversations at once (requests tagged rid=<id>)
426:         self._routes: dict[int, queue.Queue] = {}       # rid -> its lines (multi)
427:         self._routes_lock = threading.Lock()
428:         self._rids = itertools.count(1)
429:         self._tls = threading.local()                   # the request this thread is generating (pause())
430:         self.last = {}
431:         self.info = {}                   # INFO key=value facts (engine 0.1.8+): kv, expert slots, ... (Monitor tab)
432:         self.prefill_tok_s_mean = None
433:         self.progress = None             # (read, total, reuse, ms) prompt progress while a prompt is read, from PP lines
434:         try:                             # a ready-made engine's BUILD.json says its version
435:             self.info["version"] = json.loads((Path(exe).parent / "BUILD.json").read_text()).get("version")
436:         except (OSError, ValueError):
437:             self.info["version"] = None
438:         for line in self.proc.stdout:
439:             if line.startswith("NOTE "):
440:                 print("[maya] " + line[5:].strip(), flush=True)
441:             if line.startswith("INFO "):
442:                 for kv in line.split()[1:]:
443:                     k, _, v = kv.partition("=")
444:                     self.info[k] = int(v) if v.lstrip("-").isdigit() else v
445:             if line.startswith("READY"):
446:                 f = line.split()
447:                 self.max_context = int(f[1])
448:                 self.can_stop = "stop" in f[2:]
449:                 self.can_pause = "pause" in f[2:]
450:                 self.multi = next((int(x[6:]) for x in f[2:] if x.startswith("multi=") and x[6:].isdigit()), 0)
451:                 break
452:         loading.set()
453:         if self.max_context <= 0:
454:             raise RuntimeError("the engine exited before it was ready" + (f" (see {log})" if log else ""))
455:         # (from PR #41, midhatn) a locally built engine can sit next to another release's BUILD.json: engines that
456:         # report their own version (INFO engine=, 0.1.8+) win, the manifest stays the fallback for older ones
457:         if self.info.get("engine"):
458:             self.info["version"] = str(self.info["engine"])

2723:         def _authorized(self) -> bool:
2724:             if not svc.api_key:
2725:                 return True
2726:             auth = self.headers.get("Authorization", "")
2727:             given = auth[7:].strip() if auth.lower().startswith("bearer ") else self.headers.get("x-api-key", "")
2728:             if given and any(hmac.compare_digest(given.encode(), k.encode()) for k in key_list(svc.api_key)):
2729:                 return True
2730:             self._json(401, {"error": {"type": "authentication_error", "message": "missing or wrong API key"}})
2731:             return False

https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/blob/5c970a863ce2fdd87b6e23ffb4822f6d76522b1c/serve/frontend.py#L32-L46
32: class ChatTemplate:
33:     """The model's chat template, rendered with the same Jinja settings as transformers' apply_chat_template."""
34:
35:     def __init__(self, path: str | Path):
36:         def raise_exception(message):
37:             raise jinja2.exceptions.TemplateError(message)
38:
39:         def tojson(x, ensure_ascii=False, indent=None, separators=None, sort_keys=False):
40:             return json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=ensure_ascii, indent=indent, separators=separators, sort_keys=sort_keys)
41:
42:         env = ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment(trim_blocks=True, lstrip_blocks=True, extensions=["jinja2.ext.loopcontrols"])
43:         env.filters["tojson"] = tojson
44:         env.globals["raise_exception"] = raise_exception
45:         self.source = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
46:         self.template = env.from_string(self.source)

https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/blob/5c970a863ce2fdd87b6e23ffb4822f6d76522b1c/serve/frontend.py#L90-L100
90: QWEN_EFFORT = {"low": "low", "high": "medium", "max": "xhigh"}   # the same levels in a Qwen3.x template's words
91:
92:
93: def effort_level(value) -> str | None:
94:     """A client's spelling -> the level's name (none / low / high / max); None when none is given or it is unknown."""
95:     if value is None or value == "":
96:         return None
97:     if value is False:
98:         return "none"
99:     key = str(value).strip().lower()
100:     return (EFFORT[key] or "none") if key in EFFORT else None

https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/blob/5c970a863ce2fdd87b6e23ffb4822f6d76522b1c/serve/mcp.py#L594-L620
594: def _check_server(name, cfg, where) -> dict:
595:     if not isinstance(cfg, dict):
596:         raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r} must be an object with \"command\" or \"url\"")
597:     if cfg.get("url"):
598:         if cfg.get("type") == "sse":
599:             raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r} uses the old SSE transport (\"type\": \"sse\"); "
600:                              "Strata speaks Streamable HTTP - most servers offer it at /mcp")
601:         if not isinstance(cfg.get("headers") or {}, dict):
602:             raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r}: \"headers\" must be an object")
603:         return cfg
604:     if not isinstance(cfg.get("command"), str) or not cfg["command"].strip():
605:         raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r} needs \"command\" (a program to start) or \"url\"")
606:     if not isinstance(cfg.get("args") or [], list):
607:         raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r}: \"args\" must be a list")
608:     if not isinstance(cfg.get("env") or {}, dict):
609:         raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: MCP server {name!r}: \"env\" must be an object")
610:     return cfg
611:
612:
613: def servers_from(block, where: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
614:     """{"name": {...}} with the entries checked; `"disabled": true` leaves one out."""
615:     if block is None:
616:         return {}
617:     if not isinstance(block, dict):
618:         raise SystemExit(f"[maya] {where}: the MCP servers must be an object {{\"name\": {{...}}}}")
619:     return {str(n): _check_server(n, c, where) for n, c in block.items()
620:             if not (isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("disabled") is True)}

https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/blob/5c970a863ce2fdd87b6e23ffb4822f6d76522b1c/serve/mcp.py#L641-L659
641: def hub_from_config(cfg: dict, mcp_config_path: str | None = None) -> McpHub | None:
642:     """The run config's `"mcp_servers"` (or `"mcpServers"`) plus the servers in the --mcp-config file (Claude
643:     Desktop's format: {"mcpServers": {...}}); a name in both takes the file's entry.  None when there are none."""
644:     servers = {}
645:     servers.update(servers_from(cfg.get("mcp_servers"), "config mcp_servers"))
646:     servers.update(servers_from(cfg.get("mcpServers"), "config mcpServers"))
647:     if mcp_config_path:
648:         try:
649:             with open(mcp_config_path, encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
650:                 data = json.load(f)
651:         except (OSError, ValueError) as e:
652:             raise SystemExit(f"[maya] --mcp-config {mcp_config_path}: {e}") from None
653:         block = data.get("mcpServers", data.get("mcp_servers")) if isinstance(data, dict) else None
654:         if block is None:
655:             raise SystemExit(f"[maya] --mcp-config {mcp_config_path}: expected {{\"mcpServers\": {{...}}}}")
656:         servers.update(servers_from(block, f"--mcp-config {mcp_config_path}"))
657:     if not servers:
658:         return None
659:     return McpHub(servers, settings_from(cfg))
